chunk.content: Kembung (Rastrelliger spp.), the fish known as gembolo or gambolo in West Sumatra, has a dark blue-green to brownish back with one or two rows of dark spots near the dorsal fin base and silvery ventral scales.
chunk.source_quote: Sisi dorsal gelap, biru kehijauan hingga kecoklatan, dengan 1–2 deret bintik gelap membujur di dekat pangkal sirip punggung; sisik ventral keperakan.
